snippet.title: Jeremy Ethier
snippet.description:
This channel is focused on providing science-backed training and nutrition videos in order to help you become the best version of yourself. I'm a fitness coach, Kinesiology graduate, and published researcher based in Vancouver, Canada. I focus on providing science-based information to help you optimize your training and nutrition.

Get your personalized training and nutrition plan here:
https://builtwithscience.com/
